veranderings.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
veranderings.voor: Shaka het baie van sy ma Nandi gehou.
veranderings.na: Shaka was baie lief vir sy ma Nandi.
veranderings.rede: 'Lief vir' is the natural idiom for love of a mother; 'baie van ... gehou' sounds flat.

veranderings.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
veranderings.rede: 'Verslae uit daardie tyd' is the idiomatic way to say reports from that period.

veranderings.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
veranderings.rede: AWS writes compounds as one word; the hyphen is not needed here (note: the protected word 'rou' stays inside the compound).

veranderings.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
veranderings.rede: Avoids 'afgedwing ... te dwing' in the same sentence; 'reëls opgelê' is the natural collocation.

veranderings.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
veranderings.voor: Mense wat nie wou luister nie is gedood
veranderings.na: Mense wat nie wou luister nie, is gedood
veranderings.rede: A comma after the embedded clause separates 'nie' from the main verb and makes the sentence easier to read.

veranderings.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
veranderings.rede: 'Dit' refers back to the plural 'verslae' loosely; naming them is clearer and avoids reading 'dit' as the exaggeration.

veranderings.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
veranderings.voor: het dit saam met Mbopha gedoen
veranderings.na: het die moord saam met Mbopha gepleeg
veranderings.rede: 'Dit gedoen' is vague; naming the deed is clearer without repeating 'vermoor'.

veranderings.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
veranderings.na: terwyl Shaka se leërs weg was
veranderings.rede: After three other men are named, 'sy' could point to Mbopha or a half-brother; naming Shaka removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
veranderings.rede: 'Hul eie huis opsit' is the natural form of the idiom.

veranderings.blok: Wat gebly het en wat verander het
veranderings.voor: Die manier waarop gemeenskappe ingerig was en leiers se mag het wel baie verander.
veranderings.na: Leiers se mag en die manier waarop gemeenskappe ingerig was, het wel baie verander.
veranderings.rede: In the original 'en leiers se mag' reads as part of the relative clause; putting it first makes the double subject clear.

vlae.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
vlae.teks: Mbopha was een van Shaka se naaste dienaars (lyfwag).
vlae.rede: The bare '(lyfwag)' in brackets reads unclearly: it is not plain whether Mbopha was a bodyguard or 'lyfwag' is a gloss for 'dienaars'. A writer should say it in a full phrase; I did not guess which is meant.
